comment: Widget: label of the round check button that marks the meal in front as eaten, read by VoiceOver; also the action on a row's status mark. The action, not the state.
Widget, Today's Meals: VoiceOver label of a row's status mark when the meal is already marked; tapping it takes the mark back.

Widget: small capsule button shown in the morning until a meal is marked. Tapping it says the person just got up, so today's meals move later. Very short: fits beside a check button on the small widget.
Widget: VoiceOver label of the morning 'I'm up' button, saying what it does.
en: I’m up: start today’s meals from now
es: Ya me levanté: empezar las comidas de hoy desde ahora

comment: Widget: VoiceOver label of the chip that opens step-by-step cooking for the meal in front.
Widget: one-word chip beside a pan icon that opens step-by-step cooking for the meal in front. Keep it to one short word.
Widget: under the bar that runs out while a meal is on now. %@ is the time the next meal takes its place, e.g. 15:00 or 3:00 PM.
Widget: VoiceOver label of the '+45 min' chip on a meal moved later because the day started late. %@ is a duration such as '45 minutes' or '1 hour, 30 minutes'.
Widget, Today's Meals large: header line. %1$@ is the plan's name, %2$lld today's day of the plan, %3$lld the number of days in the plan, e.g. 'Keto · Day 3 of 14'.
Widget, Today's Meals large: one line standing for the meals before the one in front when there is no room for them. %1$lld is how many, %2$lld how many of them were eaten.
Widget, Day Progress: line under the ring. %1$lld is how many of today's meals are behind (eaten, skipped or past), %2$lld how many today has.

Widget, Today's Meals large: bottom line when calories are shown. %1$@ is the energy of the meals eaten so far (a number), %2$@ the energy of everything planned today with its unit, e.g. '820 of 1,640 kcal eaten'. Never phrase it as a budget or as 'left'.
Widget with no meal plan yet: title inviting the person to photograph the list their dietitian gave them.
es: Fotografía la lista de tu dietista

comment: Widget with no meal plan yet: line under the title. %@ is the app's name.
en: Add a photo, PDF or text and %@ builds your plan.
tr: Fotoğraf, PDF ya da metin ekle; planını %@ hazırlasın.
es: Añade una foto, un PDF o un texto y %@ preparará tu plan.

comment: Widget with no meal plan yet: chip that opens adding a plan.
Widget after a plan that does not repeat has ended: chip that opens the plan to start it again.
Widget after a plan has ended: chip that opens adding a new plan, with the assistant or from a list.
Widget after a plan has ended. %1$@ is the plan's name, %2$@ the date of its last day, e.g. 'Oct 12'.
Widget gallery example: the name of the example meal plan, shown in the large widget's header.
Widget gallery example: a breakfast dish. Short, appetising, typical for the language.
Widget gallery example: the lunch dish shown as the meal on now. Short, appetising.
es: Pollo a la plancha con ensalada griega

comment: Widget gallery example: an afternoon snack.
Widget gallery example: a dinner dish.
Widget gallery: name of the widget showing the next meal. Same words as the Widgets tab uses for it.
Widget gallery: description of the Next Meal widget, under its name. One or two short sentences that make people want it.
en: Your next meal and its time, always in sight. Mark it eaten right from your Home Screen.
tr: Sıradaki öğünün ve saati hep gözünün önünde. Ana Ekran'dan tek dokunuşla Yedim de.
es: Tu próxima comida y su hora, siempre a la vista. Márcala como hecha desde la pantalla de inicio.

comment: Widget gallery: name of the widget listing all of today's meals. Same words as the Widgets tab uses for it.
Widget gallery: description of the Today's Meals widget.
en: Your whole day at a glance: what’s on now, what’s next, and how the day is going.
tr: Bütün günün tek bakışta: şimdi ne var, sırada ne var, gün nasıl gidiyor.
es: Todo tu día de un vistazo: lo de ahora, lo siguiente y cómo va el día.

comment: Widget gallery: name of the widget with a ring for the day's meals. Same words as the Widgets tab uses for it.
Widget gallery: description of the Day Progress widget.
en: A ring that fills as your meals go by, with the next one right underneath.
tr: Öğünlerin geçtikçe dolan bir halka; hemen altında sıradaki öğün.
es: Un anillo que se llena con cada comida, con la siguiente justo debajo.

comment: Control Center control: name in the controls gallery. Says the person just got up, so today's meals move later.
Control Center control: the label on the button itself.
Control Center control: description in the controls gallery.
en: For mornings that start late: today’s meals move to start from now.
tr: Geç başlayan sabahlar için: bugünün öğünleri şimdiden başlar.
es: Para mañanas que empiezan tarde: las comidas de hoy empiezan desde ahora.

comment: Control Center control: name in the controls gallery. Marks the meal on now, or the next one, as eaten.
Control Center control: the label on the button itself. The action of marking a meal eaten.
Control Center control: description in the controls gallery.
en: Marks the meal that’s on now, or the next one, as eaten.
tr: Şu anki ya da sıradaki öğünü yedim olarak işaretler.
es: Marca como hecha la comida de ahora o la siguiente.

comment: App Intent title (Shortcuts): takes back the mark on a meal so it is open again.
App Intent description (Shortcuts) for taking back the mark on a meal.
en: Takes back a meal marked eaten or skipped, so it’s open again.
tr: Yedim ya da atlandı olarak işaretlenen bir öğünü geri alır; öğün yeniden açık olur.
es: Quita la marca de una comida hecha u omitida para que vuelva a estar pendiente.

comment: App Intent title of the widget's and Control Center's 'I'm up' button: the day starts now and today's meals move later.
App Intent description of the widget's 'I'm up' button.
en: Starts today from now: the first meal in half an hour, the rest of the day after it.
tr: Bugünü şimdiden başlatır: ilk öğün yarım saat sonra, günün geri kalanı arkasından.
es: Empieza el día desde ahora: la primera comida en media hora y el resto detrás.

comment: App Intent title (Shortcuts): takes back the mark on a meal so it is open again.
App Intent description (Shortcuts) for taking back the mark on a meal.
en: Takes back a meal marked eaten or skipped, so it’s open again.
tr: Yedim ya da atlandı olarak işaretlenen bir öğünü geri alır; öğün yeniden açık olur.
es: Quita la marca de una comida hecha u omitida para que vuelva a estar pendiente.

comment: App Intent title of the widget's and Control Center's 'I'm up' button: the day starts now and today's meals move later.
App Intent description of the widget's 'I'm up' button.
en: Starts today from now: the first meal in half an hour, the rest of the day after it.
tr: Bugünü şimdiden başlatır: ilk öğün yarım saat sonra, günün geri kalanı arkasından.
es: Empieza el día desde ahora: la primera comida en media hora y el resto detrás.

comment: Widgets tab: VoiceOver value of the widget previews, which preview of how many is shown. %1$lld is its position, %2$lld how many there are.
Widgets tab: footer under the steps for adding the widget. %@ is the app's name. A Smart Stack is the iOS stack of widgets that turns by itself.
en: In a Smart Stack, %@ comes to the top by itself at mealtimes.
tr: Akıllı Yığın’da %@, öğün saatlerinde kendiliğinden en üste çıkar.
es: En una pila inteligente, %@ sube sola arriba a la hora de comer.

comment: Widgets tab: switch that shows the round 'Eaten' button on the widgets.
Widgets tab: footer under the timing settings.
en: When a meal's time comes it stays on the widget for this long, then the next one takes its place. Nothing needs tapping. The Eaten button is for moving on sooner.
tr: Öğünün saati geldiğinde widget'ta bu süre boyunca kalır, sonra yerini sıradaki öğün alır. Hiçbir şeye dokunman gerekmez. Yedim düğmesi daha erken geçmek içindir.
es: Cuando llega la hora de una comida, se queda en el widget este tiempo y luego da paso a la siguiente. No hace falta tocar nada. El botón Comida hecha sirve para pasar antes.

comment: Widgets tab: segment of the size picker, and the size in a preview's caption, for widgets on the Lock Screen.
Widgets tab: switch that keeps meal names out of sight on Lock Screen widgets until the iPhone is unlocked.
es: Ocultar comidas con el iPhone bloqueado
